issues.legal_issue: A litigant who suppresses material facts or fails to disclose an earlier proceeding seeking substantially the same relief abuses the process of court and may be denied relief under Article 226 without consideration of the merits.

The Governing Board has statutory authority to issue standing orders and constitute committees, including determining their composition and functions, to discharge its duties and implement the approved Master Plan.
Neither the Residents’ Assembly nor an individual resident has a legal or statutory right to membership in a committee or council constituted by the Governing Board.
The Residents’ Assembly’s role under the Auroville Foundation Act is limited to advising the Governing Board on resident-related activities and making the specified recommendations.
The Standing Order reconstituting the Auroville Town Development Council was valid and was not rendered unlawful by replacing Residents’ Assembly nominees with Governing Board nominees.
